description:
NEW FILES:
- apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/ui.ex
- apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/ui/stub.ex

UI BEHAVIOUR (ui.ex):
Read ui_context.ex to get the full list of fn-fields. Define @callback for each:
set_status/2 (pid, text), notify/2 (pid, msg), custom/3 (pid, factory, opts), get_theme/1, set_theme/2, get_all_themes/1, apply_fg/3, apply_bg/3, select/3, request_render/1.

Also define client-side API functions matching the behaviour -- extensions call UI.set_status(ctx.ui, text) rather than calling the GenServer directly.

Context.t() type annotation: change ui: UIContext.t() | nil to ui: pid() | nil. The UIContext.t() struct is NOT deleted yet -- that is Phase 9. This ticket only adds the new type and behaviour; existing UIContext.new/bind usage in tests continues to work.

UI.STUB (ui/stub.ex):
GenServer implementing UI behaviour. No-ops all side-effecting calls (set_status, notify, etc.). Records calls as [{action, args}]. Returns sensible defaults for query calls (get_theme returns %{}, get_all_themes returns []). Expose: Stub.calls(pid) -> list.

NO existing files change except context.ex type annotation.

TEST: New ui_test.exs. Test that Stub records calls, returns defaults, does not crash on any callback.
title: Define UI behaviour and UI.Stub
